speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Carbon Monoxide Poisoning. The patient's history of heavy smoking (30 pack-years) combined with altered mental status, while completely denying fever, headache, or chest pain, is highly suggestive of CO poisoning. The normal carboxyhemoglobin result may be a false negative due to high oxygen saturation or the specific timing of the draw; I will proceed with a definitive diagnosis based on the clinical picture of a toxic exposure in a high-risk patient.
